# function: dashboards

Renders the same output as the `mixtool_dashboards` data source, without a data block. Requires Terraform 1.8 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
output "dashboards" {
  value = provider::mixtool::dashboards("${path.module}/mixin.libsonnet", ["${path.module}/vendor"])
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
dashboards(source string, jsonnet_path list of string) map of string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `source` (String) Path to the mixin Jsonnet file. Use `path.module` in modules.
1. `jsonnet_path` (List of String) Directories to search for Jsonnet imports. Pass `[]` if the mixin has no imports.
